title: Equality problem for generalized quasiarithmetic means generated by discontinuous strictly monotonic functions
summary: We study the equality problem of generalized quasiarithmetic means for a strictly monotonic generator $f$ that is not necessarily continuous. We provide two sufficient conditions that lead to a conclusion analogous to the result of Páles and Pasteczka. We show through an example that in our case, without any extra conditions, the generator functions cannot be expected to be affine transformations of each other over the whole domain.
